_comment: Active route-selection goal. This is an ontology/provenance and identifiability audit, not a model-training or SOTA goal.
goal: Determine whether uncertainty-aware extant TE loci can be annotated reproducibly and whether frozen P3 atoms contain non-geometric single-genome relation information sufficient for safe multipart locus grouping.
objective: Execute the serial L/O/E gates in docs/experiments/FBTI-EXTANT-LOCUS-PHASE0-R1-20260831.md. Stop at the first failed gate and preserve its distinct scientific interpretation.
current_contract_blocks: exact FlyBase name frequency is degenerate and exact-name-matched FPR has no denominator
joint challenge-panel feasibility and the fixed 172-package manifest are not yet complete
P3 probabilities are unavailable; Gate E input/resource contract must be revised after Gates L and O before any export
authorized_work: freeze exact r6.68 provenance, sequence and P3 canonical-atom inputs
prepare the pre-sampled 120 main and 40 reserve non-overlapping packages
run double-blind Pass-1 annotation and third-person adjudication
project frozen P3 atoms only after Pass-1 is version-locked
run CPU-only Gate L, Gate O and Gate E analyses in order
closed_work: new U-Net, boundary-loss, HMM, CRF, semi-Markov or graph-decoder rescue
historical deletion or ancestral-boundary labels from one extant sequence
FlyBase positive-only whole-genome precision or F1 claims

claim_policy.negative_scope: the first failed L/O/E gate and its explicitly bounded mechanism

stop_rules.L_P: If FBti provenance cannot support extant-locus anchors, stop relation modelling and construct an independent locus truth source.
stop_rules.L_R: If the extant-locus ontology is not reproducible, stop supervised modelling and report ambiguity rather than asking a model to replace absent truth.
stop_rules.L_D: If the frozen 160-package maximum lacks the required denominator, close relation training on this asset without claiming sequence-only impossibility.
stop_rules.O: If oracle grouping has insufficient value, close P3-as-atom grouping and do not change losses or heads on the same atoms.
stop_rules.E: If sequence/structure evidence does not safely exceed geometry, allow only a genuinely new observation such as comparative empty-site evidence.
